title: This GitHub Project Gives AI Agents a 3D Office
description:
What if AI agents didn't just chat...

...but worked together inside a virtual office you could actually watch?

In this video, I break down an open-source project that lets you visualize AI agents collaborating in a 3D workspace.

Here's what it does:

• Assigns agents different roles
• Splits projects into tasks automatically
• Shows agents collaborating in real time
• Notifies you when human input is needed
• Runs directly in your browser with a 3D interface

Built with Three.js and powered by Gemini, it's one of the most interesting demonstrations of multi-agent collaboration I've seen.

While it's a demo rather than a production workflow, it offers a glimpse into how AI collaboration interfaces could evolve.

Check the pinned comment for the GitHub repo and setup guide.

#ai #aiagents #opensource #github #gemini #threejs #automation #artificialintelligence #developers #technews
